audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 3 and 4 disagreed with the already-applied mirror, which set Level 2 to Skill and Levels 4-5 and Level 6 to Ornn. Row 6 is a genuine conflict I did not resolve.
audit.why: Level 2 is not a Yasuo window against a tank whose Volcanic Rupture is up every 9s; 4-5 and 6 belong to Ornn once Searing Charge and Call of the Forge God are online. Row 6 is different: the mirror says Yasuo at two-plus items, while this packet's chart, this page's row, and every line of late-game prose here say Ornn takes over on masterwork scaling. Flipping it would mean inventing a late-game power shift I cannot support, so I left it and raised it.
audit.corrected: Proposed three paired flips (phases[N].side + win[N]) for rows 1, 3 and 4, plus rewrites of whys[1], whys[3] and whys[4] so no line claims a stage the chart no longer gives. Row 6 untouched, question recorded.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] called Level 6 'a skill window' when Call of the Forge God is the hardest spike in the matchup, and no spike carried a cooldown.
audit.why: Call of the Forge God is 140s at rank 1 with a recast, applies Brittle and knocks up twice; Searing Charge is 14s at rank 1 and is the tool that decides every trade before it.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[4] as Ornn's spike and put Searing Charge's 14s into spikes[0].text, dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page states in seven places that Volcanic Rupture is a projectile Wind Wall blocks. It is not. It also had Q as the Brittle applier in wants.foe[0], and spikes[0] told the player to 'Wind Wall his Q brittle setup'.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is a ground fissure that leaves a magma pillar — Riot's text describes a ground slam, and the kit gives it slow, terrain and zone but no projectile flag. Brittle comes from Bellows Breath (W) and Call of the Forge God (R), never from Q. The interaction the page missed entirely is the real one: Searing Charge only knocks up when it collides with terrain, and Ornn's own Q pillar is terrain — so Q-then-E is his whole engage, and standing away from a fresh pillar defuses it.
audit.corrected: Rewrote tldr, winCon, report[0].t, report[1].t, report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].t, dosFull[1].d, spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0] around the pillar-into-charge combo instead of a wall that does nothing.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ornn.json Q flags and text, E text

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Wind Wall stops Bellows Breath is unresolved, and it is the one thing that would give the wall a job in this lane.
audit.why: Ornn's W carries the projectile flag, but Riot's description ('Ornn advances, breathing fire') reads as a cone he walks forward with, not a fired object. The mirror audit hit exactly the same wall and refused to state it in either direction.
audit.corrected: No edit. This page happens never to claim it either way — it only says to poke when W is down, which is true regardless — so nothing needed removing. Recorded as unverified.

notes: Biggest fix: the page said Volcanic Rupture is a projectile Wind Wall blocks, in seven places including tldr and the win condition. It is a ground fissure with a magma pillar — the wall does nothing, and the pillar is the terrain Searing Charge needs to knock you up. Row 6 of the chart is left alone deliberately: the mirror gives two-plus items to Yasuo while this packet, this page and all its late-game prose give it to Ornn's masterwork scaling. That needs a human, and it is in questionsForUser. suspectNames flagged 'Land Volcanic Rupture' — the name was correct, but the claim around it (Q applying Brittle) was not, and that is fixed.
